protocol: All hypotheses RESEARCH_ONLY. No promotion path in this phase. Sensitivity ranges (CLASS C) evaluated only post-validation, never selected. CLASS D dimensions forbidden.
risk_semantics: PositionSizer + MAX_ALLOCATION_PER_TRADE(500 notional) + LEVERAGE(10) + STARTING_BALANCE(2000) + RISK_PER_TRADE(0.01), identical to certified production math. Commission/slippage per 11F cost scenarios A-D.
execution_semantics: Signal-bar decisions execute NEXT_BAR_OPEN (no same-bar lookahead). Retest entries are LIMIT touch fills on subsequent bars. Pending orders expire after maximum_wait_bars. SL-first ambiguity. Single position per symbol.

hypotheses.name: Liquidity Sweep Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Stops clustered at equal lows/highs get swept (liquidity taken), trapping breakout traders; reclaim signals absorption and reversal.
hypotheses.entry_condition: wick sweeps equal low/high AND sweep bar closes back inside the level
hypotheses.confirmation_condition: close-back-inside on the sweep bar itself (no extra bar)
hypotheses.expected_holding_period: minutes to a few hours (1m bars)
hypotheses.expected_liquidity_assumption: $500 notional fills at touch/open on BTC/ETH 1m (documented assumption, tested in execution robustness)

hypotheses.name: Sweep Displacement FVG Retest
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Sweep + impulsive displacement marks institutional activity; the resulting fair value gap is revisited before continuation.
hypotheses.entry_condition: sweep, then displacement bar (range > 2x ATR14), then FVG formed; LIMIT entry at FVG edge retest within 5 bars
hypotheses.stop_definition: beyond FVG far edge + 0.25x ATR14 buffer
hypotheses.execution_model: LIMIT touch fill on retest bars; NEXT_BAR_OPEN not used
hypotheses.expected_liquidity_assumption: $500 notional LIMIT fills at FVG edge
expected_failure_modes: FVG never retested (missed moves, not losses)

hypotheses.name: Wyckoff Spring
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In a defined trading range, a spring (false breakdown with reclaim) shakes out weak holders before markup.
hypotheses.entry_condition: range (Donchian-50 high/low held >= 30 bars), wick below range low, close back inside range
hypotheses.confirmation_condition: reclaim close inside range on the spring bar
hypotheses.invalidation_condition: close back below range low (failed spring)
hypotheses.unavailable-data_behavior: effort-vs-result uses PROXY_FEATURE volume ratio only (labeled)

hypotheses.name: Wyckoff Upthrust
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Mirror of H11F-003: false breakout above range with reclaim signals distribution before markdown.
hypotheses.entry_condition: range (Donchian-50 high/low held >= 30 bars), wick above range high, close back inside range
hypotheses.confirmation_condition: reclaim close inside range on the upthrust bar
hypotheses.invalidation_condition: close back above range high (failed upthrust)
hypotheses.unavailable-data_behavior: effort-vs-result uses PROXY_FEATURE volume ratio only (labeled)

hypotheses.name: Order Block Sweep Displacement
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Last opposite candle before displacement (order block) marks institutional entry; sweep of nearby liquidity + retest offers entry with structural invalidation.
hypotheses.entry_condition: sweep + displacement (range > 2x ATR14); OB = last opposite-range candle before displacement; LIMIT entry at OB edge retest within 5 bars
hypotheses.stop_definition: beyond OB far extreme + 0.25x ATR14 buffer
hypotheses.execution_model: LIMIT touch fill on retest bars
hypotheses.expected_liquidity_assumption: $500 notional LIMIT fills at OB edge
expected_failure_modes: overlapping OB ambiguity resolved by most-recent rule (documented)

hypotheses.name: Breaker Structure Retest
hypotheses.economic_rationale: A broken support/resistance that fails to hold flips polarity (breaker); retest of the flipped level offers continuation entry.
hypotheses.entry_condition: swing BOS (3/3 confirmed), price returns through the broken level (breaker flip), LIMIT entry at flipped level retest within 5 bars
hypotheses.confirmation_condition: close through the broken level (flip confirmed)
hypotheses.execution_model: LIMIT touch fill on retest bars
hypotheses.expected_liquidity_assumption: $500 notional LIMIT fills at flipped level
expected_failure_modes: wide stops on volatile swings erode R expectancy

hypotheses.name: Trend Displacement FVG Continuation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: With-trend displacement + FVG retest continues the prevailing move; trend filter avoids counter-trend FVG traps.
hypotheses.entry_condition: close above EMA50 (long) / below (short); displacement (range > 2x ATR14) with trend; FVG formed; LIMIT entry at FVG edge retest within 5 bars
hypotheses.stop_definition: beyond FVG far edge + 0.25x ATR14 buffer
hypotheses.invalidation_condition: stop touch, trend flip (close crosses EMA50), or 5-bar wait expiry
hypotheses.execution_model: LIMIT touch fill on retest bars
hypotheses.expected_liquidity_assumption: $500 notional LIMIT fills at FVG edge
expected_failure_modes: FVGs in strong trends never retest

hypotheses.name: Range Extreme RSI Fade
hypotheses.economic_rationale: At a mature range extreme with stretched momentum (RSI), exhaustion favors reversion to the range midline.
hypotheses.entry_condition: Donchian-100 range; touch of range extreme + RSI14 <= 25 (long at low) / >= 75 (short at high)
hypotheses.confirmation_condition: same-bar touch + RSI extreme (no extra bar)
expected_failure_modes: range breaks (trend emergence) produce the largest losses
RSI pins at extremes during trends
